paragraphs: Network Engineer with 4+ years of experience designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise network infrastructures across financial services and global enterprise environments. Skilled in network infrastructure management, routing & switching, network security, SD-WAN, VPN technologies, cloud networking, and network performance monitoring to deliver secure, highly available, and resilient network services.

Experienced in optimizing enterprise network operations, implementing hybrid cloud connectivity, strengthening security compliance, and resolving complex network incidents through proactive monitoring and root cause analysis. Strong collaborator with expertise in infrastructure lifecycle management, change management, and cross-functional support to enhance operational efficiency, business continuity, and service reliability.
